description: List the document pages. Per page: page_id, index (0-based), side (LEFT_HAND, RIGHT_HAND or SINGLE_SIDED), parent (the applied master page, "[None]" when there is none) and name, which is the printed page number. Read-only. Master pages themselves are listed by list_parent_pages.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

name: list_pages
title: List pages
